title: tha ye haram me shoro buka wawaila
body:
tha ye haram me shoro buka wawaila maara gaya qasim dulha wawaila
bewa hui ek shab ki suhaagan binte imame har do sara wawaila
raas na aayi shadi haaye wawaila ghar ki hui barbaadi haaye wawaila
raat ki dulhan subha ko bewa hogayi haye haye baare quda wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
laash pe dulhan ko lao wawaila raqte uroosi badlao wawaila
dulha ki soorat jald dikhado choor hai sab uske aaza wawaila
kaisi rachi shadi ran me wawaila hijr hai dulha dulhan me wawaila
baalou ko bikhro sehre ko todo laake udhado ujli rida wawaila
<<DIVIDER>>
laash liye jab aaye hussain wawaila zainab se farmaye hussain wawaila
masnad par le jaake litaado choor hai sab iske aaza wawaila
